description: This PHP source file defines a class ReturnStatus within the Opencart Admin Model Localisation namespace. The class provides methods to manage return status records in the database, including adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving return statuses and their descriptions. It interacts with the database and cache, and is intended to be used as part of the OpenCart e-commerce platform's administrative backend for handling return status data.

classes.name: ReturnStatus
classes.description: This class manages return status records within the OpenCart localisations, providing CRUD operations and retrieval methods for return statuses and their descriptions.

methods.name: addReturnStatus
methods.description: Creates a new return status record in the database, inserting the main return status data and associated descriptions for each language, then clears the relevant cache.

methods.name: editReturnStatus
methods.description: Edits an existing return status by deleting the current record and re-adding descriptions for the specified return status ID, followed by cache clearing.

methods.name: deleteReturnStatus
methods.description: Deletes a return status record from the database based on its ID and clears the cache.

methods.name: deleteReturnStatusesByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all return status records associated with a specific language ID and clears the cache.

methods.name: getReturnStatus
methods.description: Retrieves a specific return status record from the database based on the return status ID, considering the current language configuration.

methods.name: getReturnStatuses
methods.description: Retrieves a list of return status records, applying filters such as language, sorting, and pagination, with results cached for performance.

methods.name: getTotalReturnStatuses
methods.description: Returns the total count of return status records for a given language, useful for pagination.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a description for a specific return status and language, inserting into the database.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions associated with a specific language ID.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Fetches a specific description of a return status for a given return status ID and language ID.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all descriptions for a particular return status, indexed by language ID.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves all return status descriptions associated with a specific language ID.
